role: calibration: idoneal reframing of the Mordell classes (B1)
missing_theorem: None for ES. Correct reframing: the six Mordell classes are the coprime squares mod 840. (ℤ/840)^× has 1·1·2·3 = 6 squares. Since 840 is idoneal they coincide with primes x² + 840y² (principal genus = principal form). Mordell–Schinzel says square classes mod any M are never covered by polynomial identities, so the idoneal property adds no ES information. Mod 1848 the uncovered set must again contain the squares.
